content:
Hi folks! I created a lean4-nix flake to gradually replace the deprecated flake build in the lean4 repository. It has a couple of features:

  1. Automatically read Lean version from lean-toolchain
  2. Load multiple lean4 versions at the same time is now possible with overlays
  3. lake2nix: Convert a lake-manifest.json into Nix expressions. There's a template example for building a project with the aesop dependency

Support for Lean4 starts from v4.11 since that is the version for which the nix flake was deprecated.

Building a Lean package with dependencies is as easy as

      pkgs = import nixpkgs {
        inherit system;
        overlays = [ (lean4-nix.readToolchainFile ./lean-toolchain) ];
      };
      project = (lean4-nix.lake { inherit pkgs; }).mkPackage {
        src = ./.;
      };
